meta.title: Resource Radar
meta.description: A freebie / deal / open-source / news aggregation workbench: adds a Resource Radar entry to the left navigation. Refreshing fetches RSS, triages and translates each item with the DSH default model, and routes them into channels. Includes three-level filters, a block-word firewall, favorites, read management and source management; data persists in the profile's resource-radar-data.json. Fully restart DeepSeek Harness after updating Host-side code.
